schema.name: display name
schema.extends: another room type: its rules are inherited and this type's override them
schema.traits: semantic surface traits every surface of the room carries (medical, office, ...); added to the parent's
schema.tags: room tags; added to the parent's
schema.spec: parametric room defaults (height, wall_thickness, floor, ceiling, trim, materials, lighting, collision, collision_rules, surfaces). A room's own spec overrides them; objects merge key by key, lists replace
schema.params: grammar variables the room's rules see (counter_surface, desk_surface, light_intensity, ...). They override grammar defaults, not variables set by a rule, set or the generation
schema.interior: rule name or list of rules (from the grammar, else the room_interiors grammar) run in the room's interior once its doors are known; false for none
schema.populate: surface placements for this room (see SEMANTIC-SURFACES.md); the parent's come first unless inherit_populate is false
schema.inherit_populate: false drops the parent's populate entries
schema.size: {min_width, min_length, min_height, max_width, max_length}: advisory; rooms outside it get a warning
schema.interior_variables: interior rules also see room_type, room_width, room_length, room_height, doors_on and windows_on (sides with doors / windows), wall_sides (sides without doors) and free_sides (without doors or windows), both ordered far side first, wall_side and free_side (their first entry or ''), entry_side (the first door's side, else south), back_side (opposite the entry if it has no door, else '') and long_axis (x or y)

room.name: Room
room.description: Generic room. Every built-in type extends it.

corridor.name: Corridor
corridor.description: Circulation space: flat ceiling, light anchors every 4 m, a cable tray along it (grammar variable tray) and patrol points on the floor.

office.name: Office
office.description: Desks in rows with cabinets along a free wall; a workstation marker on every desk.

reception.name: Reception
reception.description: A counter in front of the far wall and cabinets beside it.

clinic.name: Clinic
clinic.description: Bright, cool light; an examination bed, a medical counter and a cabinet. Supply spots on the medical surfaces.

storage.name: Storage
storage.description: Shelf rows on the free walls and crates in the middle; loot spots on the shelves.

security.name: Security
security.description: A monitoring desk, lockers along a free wall, a security zone volume and a guard post.

armory.name: Armory
armory.description: Weapon cabinets along the free walls.

maintenance.name: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Exposed beams, a pipe run under the ceiling, a workbench and a tool cabinet; repair spots on the bench.

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.description: Workbenches along the free walls and crates.

server_room.name: Server room
server_room.description: Raised floor, cool light, rows of racks with aisles and a cable tray.

lab.name: Laboratory
lab.description: Lab benches along the free walls; sample spots on them.

bedroom.name: Bedroom
bedroom.description: A bed against a free wall and a wardrobe.

bathroom.name: Bathroom
bathroom.description: A counter on a wall without doors.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.description: Kitchen counters along the free walls.
